messages:
maya-peopleops: Heads up — AJ starts Thu 4/2. Background check still pending (vendor says 48–72h). AJ is remote in MAD (Spain) and will use passport for I-9. Need plan for: I-9 remote exception, BG intake timing, laptop courier, benefits access, and day-1 orientation slot. Any blockers?

carlos-onboard: We can do a short workaround: mobile notary or embassy notary + courier. @lina-peopleops do we have vendor list for Madrid? Also need a scanned passport + signed I-9 once notary done.

lina-peopleops: We don't run notary abroad as standard. Options: 1) candidate books local notary (we reimburse), 2) nearby embassy/consulate notarization. Candidate prefers embassy but earliest is Tue. If start is Thu that's tight.

maya-peopleops: Vendor suggested a "remotely witnessed" attestation for some countries — candidate prefers in-person but can't wait. Proposal: temporary remote exception: accept passport scan + live video verification (recorded) now, and require notarized attestation/couriered original within 5 business days. @security ok with that?

security: Temporary exception allowed with controls: collect passport scan, do live video verify (record and store), require notarized doc within 5 business days. Create an exception ticket and attach artifacts. Also add KYC checklist to the packet.

it-support-bot: Device request queued: MacBook Air M2. Provisioning ETA 2 business days. International shipping to MAD ~3 business days. Rough total: ~5 business days to deliver once ordered. Will post tracking when shipped.

carlos-onboard: I'll arrange courier pickup Mon AM to hit the 5bd target. Maya — please send the I-9 remote-exception template to AJ and schedule the 30-min video verification call Mon. Sample template below:

```text
I-9 remote exception (temporary):
- Candidate provides passport scan to secure portal
- Live video verification with People Ops (recorded)
- Candidate obtains notarized attestation and ships to HQ within 5 business days
- Exception approved by Security (ticket SEC-xxxx)
```

maya-peopleops: Sent the template to AJ and scheduled the video verify Mon 9:30am CET. AJ confirmed availability. Created expense code ONB-NOTARY for reimbursement.

logistics-bot: Courier label created: TRACK123456789EU. Pickup scheduled Monday 09:00 local.

aj-newhire: Thanks — I'll upload my passport scan to the secure portal today and be on the video call Mon 9:30 CET. Quick Q: when does benefits enrollment open for me?

lina-peopleops: Benefits portal access opens Day 1 at 08:00 PT (we send SSO invite at that time). If BG clears earlier we'll push the invite sooner. Link for reference: https://benefits.redwood.com/enroll

maya-peopleops: :thumbsup: Perfect. I'll update the Day-1 orientation invite (30-min intro + 1:1 with manager) and confirm laptop tracking once shipped.

security: Exception ticket created SEC-2026-045 — @carlos-onboard please attach the passport scan and the meeting recording to the ticket after the verification call.

carlos-onboard: Will attach docs after call. Marking this thread: arranging courier + exception flow. Closing loop after shipping confirmation.
